span.p: Yes, suspicious or confirmed

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Alert: massive AD or LDAP user account manipulation detected

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Pull AD and LDAP logs related to user changes in alert timeframe

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Identify modified users, actor accounts, source hosts, operations and timestamps

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is the activity truly massive and unusual for this environment

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: False correlation or expected bulk change. Tune rule or thresholds and close as false positive.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Determine scope: number of users, types of changes, impacted OUs or groups

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Classify changes: create, delete, enable, disable, password reset, group membership, attribute changes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Check actor identity: admin, service account, automation account, or standard user

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is there a known change window, script, or approved request

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Confirm with change records or admin team, document as expected and allowlist pattern if needed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Mark as suspicious and proceed to triage

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Check time of activity: business hours or off hours, weekday or weekend

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Review actor account profile: privileges, roles, recent changes, new admin rights

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Review source: DC or management server or unknown host, internal or remote

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Look for risky changes: mass password reset, enable disabled accounts, add to high privilege groups

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Check user impact: critical users, privileged users, service accounts, sensitive groups

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Correlate with other telemetries like firewall, identity related alerts

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Are there strong indicators of compromise or malicious intent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Document reasoning and context. Close as benign true positive or false positive.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Escalate to security incident. Notify identity or incident response team.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Contain actor account: disable or lock, reset password, revoke sessions and tokens

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Contain impacted user accounts: revert unauthorized changes, reset passwords if needed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Contain infrastructure: restrict access from suspicious hosts, block IPs, enforce MFA or admin controls

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Collect evidence: AD security logs, LDAP logs, backup of directory state, Sumo queries and timelines

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Identify root cause: compromised admin account, stolen credentials, misconfigured scripts, insider misuse

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Eradicate: remove malware, revoke compromised credentials, fix vulnerable scripts or tools

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Recover AD state: restore from backups or snapshots, verify group memberships and critical attributes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Harden environment: implement just in time admin, tiered admin model, stronger audit and alerting, change control

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: End: incident handled, lessons learned documented, detections and processes updated
